installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# BrickMote relay - installation (runs in a temporary container, files go to /mnt/server)
set -e
apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq git ca-certificates > /dev/null
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

URL="${GIT_ADDRESS}"
if [ -n "${GIT_USERNAME}" ] && [ -n "${GIT_ACCESS_TOKEN}" ]; then
  URL="https://${GIT_USERNAME}:${GIT_ACCESS_TOKEN}@${GIT_ADDRESS#https://}"
fi

if [ -d BrickMote/.git ]; then
  echo "Mise à jour de BrickMote..."
  git -C BrickMote fetch --depth 1 "$URL" ${GIT_BRANCH:+"$GIT_BRANCH"}
  git -C BrickMote reset --hard FETCH_HEAD
else
  echo "Téléchargement de BrickMote..."
  rm -rf BrickMote
  git clone --depth 1 ${GIT_BRANCH:+--branch "$GIT_BRANCH"} "$URL" BrickMote
fi
# never keep an access token on disk
git -C BrickMote remote set-url origin "${GIT_ADDRESS}"

mkdir -p /mnt/server/relay-data
echo "Installation terminée : $(git -C BrickMote log -1 --format='%h %s')"
